name: EasyPost
description: Live EasyPost rates at checkout, labels and tracking for Swell orders

extensions.name: EasyPost
extensions.description: Live rates from your EasyPost carrier accounts

images.title: Connected in a few minutes
images.description: Paste your EasyPost API key and add the address your parcels ship from.

images.title: Live carrier rates at checkout
images.description: Turn on EasyPost in Settings → Shipping, and customers choose from USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL and more.

images.title: Labels bought for you
images.description: Buy each label from the order page, or let the app buy it when an order is paid. The order list shows each order's EasyPost status.

images.title: Tracked until delivered
images.description: Each order gets a Swell shipment with the tracking number, and an EasyPost tab with the label link and tracking status.
